content_sections.heading: NFSU Job Description
content_sections.text: Senior Developer Duties and Responsibilities Network forensics (live packet capture, protocol dissection, traffic pattern analysis). Anomaly detection and behavioral analysis for suspicious device activity, SSL/TLS inspection, DNS analysis, and C2 detection. Deleted data recovery and file carving techniques, systems programming, and portable tool development, embedded systems and hardware interfacing (USB, serial communication). Evidence handling, chain of custody, and forensic integrity. Advanced Analytics & AI: AI/ML model integration (anomaly detection, classification), experience with LLM/SLM optimization, prompt engineering, or RAG-based systems. Log Analysis & Intelligent Monitoring: log correlation across multiple data sources, anomaly detection from logs using statistical or AI-based techniques, pattern identification and behavioral analysis in system/network logs, ability to design and implement automated log analysis pipelines. Specialized Domain Knowledge: digital forensics & cyber security, mobile device analysis, malware analysis and threat investigation, OSINT tools and methodologies. Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-performance software systems in cybersecurity and digital analysis domains. Develop and integrate backend services, APIs, and data processing pipelines. Work on Linux and system-level environments, including low-level data handling and device interaction. Implement data acquisition, parsing, analysis, and correlation across multiple sources (system, network, and application data). Build analytical dashboards and visualization tools for investigation and decision support. Develop and integrate AI/ML models (including LLM/SLM) for anomaly detection and intelligent insights. Ensure forensic integrity, data security, and compliance with relevant standards and policies. Implement logging, monitoring, and automated analysis mechanisms for large-scale data. Develop cross-platform solutions and optimize for performance and portability. Generate automated reports and documentation for analysis and investigation. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure timely delivery of project objectives. Perform testing, validation, and security assessment of developed systems. Junior Developer Duties and Responsibilities Develop secure and scalable systems, work on Linux-based environments, and build APIs and data pipelines. Implement logging and monitoring mechanisms.
